properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hash.js@1.1.3 is a declared dependency of the web3/elliptic stack (elliptic@6.5.3 requires it); it ships SHA-1/SHA-224/256/384/512 into the browser bundle. Dependency declaration — the app imports web3 directly and never hash.js, but the build ships these hash implementations.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: crypto-js@3.3.0 declared in the lockfile ships MD5 among its algorithm set. Transitive dependency — no crypto-js import anywhere in src/ (verified by grep). The shipped bundle carries the MD5 implementation whether or not a runtime path reaches it; presence is what this inventory records.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-1 declared via crypto-js@3.3.0 in the lockfile — same transitive dependency as the MD5 entry; no direct app import, implementation shipped in the bundle.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1@3.8.0 native bindings plus the curve's requires across the web3 stack's lockfile entries. This is the Ethereum signature curve: every transaction this voting dApp submits (submitVote in Choice.jsx:110, approve/deposit/withdraw in Wallet.jsx) is ECDSA over secp256k1, signed by the connected wallet and verified on-chain. Fixed by the Ethereum protocol — observable here, replaceable only ecosystem-wide, not changeable in this repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RSA appears twice in this repository: dev-only node-forge (self-signed dev-server certificates) and the shipped public-encrypt/browserify-rsa polyfill capability (no application call site). Both Shor-vulnerable; encryption path migrates to ML-KEM-768.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDH (create-ecdh/elliptic) and finite-field DH (diffie-hellman@5.0.3) both ship via web3-eth-accounts → crypto-browserify; both are Shor-vulnerable key agreement — migration ML-KEM-768 (hybrid X25519MLKEM768 where a protocol context exists).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.5.3 is web3's pure-JS secp256k1 ECDSA implementation for the browser path. Dependency declaration; the app signs exclusively through web3 contract .send() and the wallet provider, never calling elliptic directly.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The 14 sites are the keccak package entries in the lockfile (keccak@3.0.1, keccak@1.4.0 nested, keccak256@1.0.0 and their requires). Keccak-256 is Ethereum's own hash — address derivation, EIP-55 checksums (web3.utils.toChecksumAddress at Choice.jsx:76/93) and transaction hashing. Consumed inside web3; no direct app call site, implementation shipped in the bundle.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: pbkdf2@^3.x browserify package declared in the lockfile (required by parse-asn1 at line 15079, part of the crypto-browserify chain that backs web3's account/keystore handling). Ethereum v3 JSON keystores specify pbkdf2 or scrypt as their KDF. Dependency declaration; no direct app call.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES capability via crypto-js (unbundled, Torus path) and aes-js (unbundled, authereum path); the DES/3DES legacy polyfill (browserify-des) rides the same bundled browserify-cipher; CWE-327-grade cipher capability with no application call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt-js@3.0.1 declared in the lockfile — the scrypt KDF implementation web3/ethereumjs use to derive keys when decrypting v3 JSON keystore files. Dependency inventory; no direct app import.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: sha.js declared in the lockfile — SHA-1/SHA-2 family streams behind browserify's create-hash, which the keccak, secp256k1 and keys packages in web3's chain depend on. Dependency inventory; no direct app import.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic — the elliptic-curve crypto provider of the web3 stack. This entry records the library itself; its secp256k1 ECDSA algorithms are recorded under ALG-710f61f0 (same package, algorithm facet). Available in the shipped bundle.

properties.name: pqs:context

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hash.js@1.1.3 — the hash provider required by elliptic. Its SHA-family algorithms are recorded under ALG-50e53f84 (same package, algorithm facet); this entry records the library itself.

properties.name: pqs:context
